small_split.scope: Frozen saved numeric rollouts, split by whole game with both seats together. Terminal targets only; actor frozen. Larger diagnostic uses four successive behavior policies. These are state-weighted prediction metrics from one split, not a new gameplay evaluation.
small_split.late_mse_definition: Last 20% of decisions within each seat trajectory, not a turn cutoff.
small_split.memory_scope: Frozen behavior memories from saved rollouts; no sequence replay/BPTT. Fresh cases reset critic weights and Adam, retaining the same numeric inputs.
